text:
David K: Quick postmortem follow-up from the 02:15 streaming incident — collecting owners & timelines for fixes (timeouts / partial responses / reconnect logic).

David K: TL;DR: 4 action items, owners, and provisional deadlines:
- reconnect backoff tuning -> Alex M (due Wed 03/05)
- client heartbeat + idle prune -> Ana P (due Fri 03/07)
- partial-chunk telemetry & alert -> Sarah (due Tue 03/11)
- runbook + automated rollback -> Jun L (due EOW 03/08)

Alex M: got it. will prototype backoff config today. proposing `initial=150ms, multiplier=1.8, max=6s, jitter=0.25` — should reduce client hammering without adding much latency.

Sarah: can you also add a short experiment to test reconnects under 1000rps? we saw failures spike at ~700rps in prod trace.

Alex M: yep. spinning up a canary with 1 pod, 10k tokens/min load generator. will post results here.

Ana P: for heartbeat pruning I'm thinking server-side idle TTL + client ping. config suggestion:
```
heartbeat.interval_ms=20000
idle_ttl_ms=90000
prune-window=30s
```
That should cover fast reconnects without dropping active sessions.

Jun L: I'll take the runbook. plan: add a checklist for detection -> mitigation -> rollback. also wire an automatic rollback if partial-response-rate > 0.5% for 5m.

ops-bot: INC-4321 linked to ticket STREAM-887; a follow-up subtask created: STREAM-887-1 (backoff config).

Sarah: telemetry items (proposed metric names): `stream.partial_chunk_rate`, `stream.reconnect_rate`, `stream.session_idle_count`. Alerts: partial_chunk_rate > 0.3% sustained 10m -> P2.

David K: good. Alex, Sarah — can you pair on the alert thresholds? partial detection false positives are noisy.

Alex M: happy to. Sarah, can you drop the datadog query? I want to see baseline.

Sarah: query draft: `sum:stream.partial_chunks{env:prod}.as_count() / sum:stream.tokens_generated{env:prod}.as_count()`. will post a dashboard panel.

Ana P: quick note — client SDK teams need a minor bump for heartbeat support. I'll make a PR and tag @devex for release notes.

Devex-bot: new PR created by Ana P: github.com/redwood/devex/sdk#452 (heartbeat + graceful-reconnect). CI: ✅

Alex M: backoff canary logs: first 30m look ok — reconnect attempts down 42%, median latency +10ms. pushing to 5% canary now.

David K: nice. please file results to STREAM-887-1 and ping infra for capacity if canary needs more nodes.

Jun L: runbook draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-reconnect-runbook — feedback welcome. added postmortem checklist and owner contacts.

Sarah: dashboard panel posted: https://dd.internal/dash/stream-partial — added alert with a 15m eval window (P2).

Ana P: PR merged for heartbeat; devex tagged; rolling to staging tonight, prod next Tue with canary.

Alex M: will push full rollout after monitoring 24h in canary; plan timeline updated in STREAM-887.

David K: cadence note — weekly 30m check-in for 3 weeks, Mondays 9am PST. I'll create a recurring invite. If someone wants different cadence reply here.

Sarah: fine for me. :thumbsup:

Jun L: fine.

Ana P: fine.

Alex M: fine.

David K: thanks all — I'll update the postmortem doc and close follow-ups as tickets get resolved. will re-open thread if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
